## Summary

Describe the single behavior or documentation outcome changed by this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] `corepack pnpm run verify`
- [ ] `git diff --check`

## Scope

- [ ] Tests cover every changed behavior claim

- [ ] The change does not claim coverage for Shell, PowerShell, Bash, or arbitrary command writes unless that coverage is implemented and tested
